# Staff Manufacturing Engineering - Atlas — Boston Dynamics

---

**Job ID:** R2864
**Date Posted:** "30+ Days Ago" (as viewed Aug 8, 2026)
**Date Applied:** Aug 8, 2026
**Salary Range:** $116,000 – $140,000

---

## Job Summary

The Staff-level counterpart to [[007 Boston Dynamics - Senior Staff Manufacturing Engineer|the Senior Staff Atlas manufacturing role]] — same Atlas program, same mission (transforming research prototypes into reliable, scalable manufacturing/field-deployment systems), same interface with Hyundai Motor Group, but a lower seniority bar. Waltham, MA.

---

## What You'll Do

Functionally identical responsibilities to the Senior Staff posting: rate-production process development and assembly workflows for Atlas; production system tooling (material flow, value stream maps, floor layouts, automation); DFM/DFA collaboration with Hardware Engineering; custom fixture/jig/tool design and validation for precision motor/actuator assembly; SOPs and work instructions; hands-on prototype build support; FAI and in-process quality; Lean/Six Sigma continuous improvement.

### Required Qualifications
- BS in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or related (Master's/PhD a plus)
- **At least 5 years** of relevant process engineering/manufacturing experience (robotics, aerospace, or complex electromechanical systems preferred) — the key difference from the Senior Staff posting's 8–15 year bar
- Same technical bar otherwise: expert CAD (SolidWorks/CATIA), DFM/DFA, custom tooling/fixtures, GD&T, Lean/Six Sigma/RCCA, precision assembly techniques

### Education
BS in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Master's or PhD a plus.

### Benefits
Not itemized beyond stated base pay range; standard Boston Dynamics compensation practices per Massachusetts pay-transparency law.

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Aug 8, 2026

- **Very strong overlap — arguably the closest years-of-experience fit in this batch:** all the same strengths as the Senior Staff posting (SolidWorks + CATIA, DFM/DFA + GD&T + Lean Manufacturing + Lean Six Sigma all explicit as of Aug 8, 2026, fixture/tooling design, proven precision electromechanical assembly work) — but here the 5-year bar is **met**, not a stretch, since professional experience runs from May 2020 (~6 years by this date).
- **Gap:** same as the Senior Staff role — no humanoid/robotics-program experience specifically, no PLM/MES or TWI certification evidence.

## About the Company

Boston Dynamics is a global robotics leader (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) blending mechanical design, control systems, and AI-driven perception for robots operating in unstructured real-world environments, and is building a commercial automation business for industrial and warehouse-logistics customers.
